docs.title: oci2vm
docs.text:
English | 简体中文

oci2vm converts container images into bootable virtual machine disk images.

It takes an image from the local Docker daemon, from a registry or built from a Dockerfile, installs a Linux kernel, a bootloader, cloud-init and an OpenSSH server with the package manager of the image distribution, and writes a qcow2, raw, vmdk, vdi, vhd, vhdx or qed disk, which boots with QEMU, libvirt, KubeVirt or VirtualBox. The image entrypoint runs as a service at boot, and the image environment is exported to login shells.

oci2vm is a fork of d2vm by Linka Cloud, licensed under the Apache License 2.0. NOTICE lists the attributions.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
1. oci2vm reads /etc/os-release in the image to select the template of its distribution.
  2. It builds a temporary image from the image and the template, which installs the kernel, the init system, the bootloader packages, cloud-init, the OpenSSH server and the network configuration.
  3. It writes the temporary image layers to a partitioned raw disk, then sets up fstab, the hostname, the name servers, the entrypoint service and the bootloader.
  4. qemu-img converts the raw disk to the output format.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/jimyag/oci2vm && cd oci2vm
make install
oci2vm convert nginx:1.27-alpine -o nginx.qcow2

Complete example builds an application image, boots it with QEMU and logs in with SSH.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Requirements:

  • Docker.
  • Go and make, to build oci2vm from source.
  • On Linux, root privileges (sudo), to set up the loop devices and mount the disk, and these packages: util-linux, udev, parted, e2fsprogs, dosfstools, mount, tar, extlinux, qemu-utils, cryptsetup (for LUKS).

On macOS and Windows, or on Linux without root privileges, the build and convert commands run in the ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm image, which already contains these packages. Windows is untested.

The releases publish the binaries themselves, named oci2vm_<os>_<arch>, with checksums.txt, and the ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm image of the same version, which the binaries pull when they need it. For example, on macOS with Apple silicon:

curl -fsSLo oci2vm https://github.com/jimyag/oci2vm/releases/latest/download/oci2vm_darwin_arm64
chmod +x oci2vm && sudo mv oci2vm /usr/local/bin/

To build oci2vm from source:

git clone https://github.com/jimyag/oci2vm && cd oci2vm
make install

make install installs the oci2vm binary in $GOBIN and builds the ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm image with the same version. To run oci2vm with Docker only, define an alias on the image:

alias oci2vm="docker run --rm -it --privileged -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v \$PWD:/oci2vm -w /oci2vm ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm:latest"

With the alias, the build context, the Dockerfile and the output must be in the current directory.

Shell completion is available for bash, zsh, fish and PowerShell:

source <(oci2vm completion zsh)

docs.title: Convert an image
docs.text:
oci2vm convert IMAGE -o disk.qcow2
  • oci2vm uses the image of the local Docker daemon when it exists, and pulls it from its registry otherwise. --pull always pulls it, and --platform linux/arm64 selects another architecture.
  • Pull the images of a private registry with docker pull first: when oci2vm runs in its image, it cannot use your registry credentials.
  • An image tarball made by docker save or podman save keeps the image configuration. Load it first:
docker load -i app.tar
oci2vm convert app:latest -o app.qcow2
  • A container filesystem tarball made by docker export has no image configuration: oci2vm then installs no entrypoint service and exports no environment. Give them back when importing it:
docker import --change 'ENV GREETING=hello' --change 'ENTRYPOINT ["/app/server"]' app-fs.tar app:fs
oci2vm convert app:fs -o app.qcow2

The image must be based on a supported distribution, with cat and /etc/os-release: distroless and scratch images cannot be converted.

docs.title: Build from a Dockerfile
docs.text:
oci2vm build -f Dockerfile --build-arg VERSION=1.0 -o disk.qcow2 .

build runs docker build on the context directory, converts the built image like convert, then removes it unless --keep-cache is set.

  • Multi-stage Dockerfiles work: oci2vm converts the image of the final stage, which must be based on a supported distribution. Use for instance alpine or debian:12-slim instead of scratch or distroless as the final stage.
  • build has no --target flag. To convert another stage, build it with Docker, then convert it:
docker build --target debug -t app:debug .
oci2vm convert app:debug -o app-debug.qcow2
  • When oci2vm runs in its image, only the context directory is mounted: the Dockerfile must be inside it.

docs.title: What the virtual machine includes
docs.text:
• The image ENTRYPOINT and CMD run at boot as the oci2vm-entrypoint service, a systemd unit or, on Alpine, an OpenRC service, with the image ENV, WORKDIR and USER. The service runs the generated /usr/local/bin/oci2vm-entrypoint script and restarts it when it fails. No service is installed when the image has no command, or only starts an interactive shell or interpreter, as the distribution and language images do (sh, bash, python3 or node for instance).
  • /etc/profile.d/oci2vm-env.sh exports the image ENV to login shells: SSH sessions, console logins and su -. HOME, HOSTNAME, LOGNAME, SHELL, TERM and USER keep the values of the login session. Commands run without a login shell, such as ssh host cmd, and the other services do not read it, except on CentOS, Rocky Linux and AlmaLinux, whose /etc/bashrc reads /etc/profile.d.
  • The variables whose names a shell cannot export, such as my-var, are skipped by the service and the login shells.
  • cloud-init applies at boot the users, SSH keys and user data of the datasource, such as a NoCloud or ConfigDrive disk, or a KubeVirt cloudInitNoCloud volume:
  • its network configuration is disabled (/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-oci2vm-network.cfg): the image one is used;
  • growpart and resize2fs let it extend the root filesystem to the disk size;
  • on Debian, Kali and Ubuntu, its locale module is disabled (99-oci2vm-locale.cfg): the locales package is missing from container images;
  • without datasource, ds-identify disables it at boot. Alpine, Debian 9 and CentOS 7 have no ds-identify: there, cloud-init only looks for NoCloud and ConfigDrive (99-oci2vm-datasource.cfg), instead of waiting minutes for the metadata services of the cloud providers.
  • An OpenSSH server starts at boot. The host keys created during the build are removed: each virtual machine generates its own.
  • The network is configured with DHCP on eth0:
Distribution Network configuration Ubuntu 18.04 and later netplan with systemd-networkd Debian, Kali, Alpine ifupdown CentOS, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux NetworkManager

--network-manager selects netplan, ifupdown or none on Debian, Kali and Ubuntu, and ifupdown or none on Alpine. - The name servers come from DHCP, unless --dns or --dns-search set them. --hostname and --add-host set the hostname and /etc/hosts entries. - When oci2vm runs as root, the output disk belongs to the user who ran sudo, or else to the owner of the output directory.

--raw converts the image as it is, without the template: the image must already contain a kernel and an init system, and gets neither cloud-init nor the OpenSSH server.

docs.title: Disk and boot options
docs.text:
Option Effect -o disk.EXT Output format from the extension: qcow2, qed, raw, vdi, vhd, vhdx, vmdk, raw when none -s 10G Disk size, 10G by default; cloud-init extends the root filesystem to it at boot -p PASSWORD Root password; prefer SSH keys provided by cloud-init --bootloader syslinux (default on amd64), grub-bios, grub-efi (the only one on arm64), or grub for BIOS and UEFI --split-boot, --boot-fs, --boot-size Separate boot partition, ext4 or fat32, 100 MB by default --luks-password Encrypts the root partition with LUKS --append-to-cmdline Extra kernel command line arguments --force Overwrites the output disk

grub and grub-efi use a FAT32 boot partition and need CentOS, Rocky Linux or AlmaLinux 9 or later. LUKS is not available before Ubuntu 20.04 and Debian 10. The command reference lists all the flags.

docs.title: Run the virtual machine
docs.text:
QEMU, amd64 disk on a Linux host with KVM:

qemu-system-x86_64 -accel kvm -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -drive file=disk.qcow2,if=virtio \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0

QEMU, arm64 disk on a Mac with Apple silicon, where the disk boots with UEFI:

qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt -accel hvf -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -bios /opt/homebrew/share/qemu/edk2-aarch64-code.fd \
  -drive file=disk.qcow2,if=virtio \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0

An amd64 disk using grub-efi also needs UEFI firmware, such as -bios /usr/share/ovmf/OVMF.fd on Ubuntu. Attach a cloud-init seed disk with -drive file=seed.iso,if=virtio,format=raw.

oci2vm run qemu, oci2vm run vbox and oci2vm run hetzner run a disk with QEMU, VirtualBox or on Hetzner Cloud: see the command reference.

For KubeVirt, --tag packages the disk as a container disk image, and --push pushes it:

oci2vm convert app:latest -o app.qcow2 --tag registry.example.com/app-disk:latest --push

docs.title: Complete example
docs.text:
examples/app builds a Go web server in a multi-stage Dockerfile, whose final stage is based on Alpine. The virtual machine runs it as a service, and cloud-init installs your SSH key for root.

  1. Replace the key in examples/app/user-data with your public key.
  2. Build the disk:
oci2vm build -o hello.qcow2 examples/app
  1. Create the cloud-init seed disk, on Linux with cloud-image-utils:
cloud-localds seed.iso examples/app/user-data examples/app/meta-data

or on macOS:

mkdir seed && cp examples/app/user-data examples/app/meta-data seed/
hdiutil makehybrid -iso -joliet -default-volume-name cidata -o seed.iso seed
  1. Boot it with QEMU, with the seed disk, forwarding the SSH and application ports. On a Linux amd64 host:
qemu-system-x86_64 -accel kvm -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -drive file=hello.qcow2,if=virtio -drive file=seed.iso,if=virtio,format=raw \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22,hostfwd=tcp::8080-:8080 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0

On a Mac with Apple silicon:

qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt -accel hvf -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -bios /opt/homebrew/share/qemu/edk2-aarch64-code.fd \
  -drive file=hello.qcow2,if=virtio -drive file=seed.iso,if=virtio,format=raw \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22,hostfwd=tcp::8080-:8080 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0
  1. Call the application and log in:
curl http://localhost:8080   # Hello from oci2vm
ssh -p 2222 root@localhost

In the virtual machine, rc-service oci2vm-entrypoint status shows the service, and echo "$GREETING" the image environment.

The examples directory also contains Dockerfiles for Ubuntu, Debian, Alpine and CentOS Stream: make examples builds all of them.

docs.title: Supported distributions
docs.text:
Distribution Tested releases Notes Ubuntu 18.04, 20.04, 22.04, 24.04, 26.04 Debian 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 9 to 11 install their packages from archive.debian.org Kali rolling tested on arm64 only Alpine 3.16, 3.20 to 3.24 OpenRC CentOS 7, 8, Stream 8, Stream 9, Stream 10 7, 8 and Stream 8 install their packages from vault.centos.org Rocky Linux 8, 9, 10 AlmaLinux 8, 9, 10

The amd64 disks were tested with KVM and syslinux, and some with grub-efi; the arm64 disks with QEMU on Apple silicon and grub-efi. RHEL, the other distributions, and the distroless and scratch images are not supported.

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• Distroless and scratch images, and final stages based on them, cannot be converted.
  • The interactive programs detected to skip the entrypoint service are sh, ash, bash, dash, zsh, python, python3, node, irb and jshell. Another interactive command, such as php -a, becomes a service that stops at once.
  • On arm64, the kernel command line uses the ttyS0 serial console, which the QEMU virt machine does not have: the serial console only shows the kernel messages, so log in with SSH.
  • Converting for another architecture than the host one runs the image under emulation: it is slow, and the CentOS 7 and Stream 8 initramfs generation fails on Apple silicon. The arm64 oci2vm image has no syslinux: amd64 disks converted on arm64 hosts need --bootloader grub-bios or grub-efi.

docs.title: Development
docs.text:
Command Effect make .build Builds the ./oci2vm binary make docker-build Builds the ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm:VERSION image make install Both, the binary in $GOBIN make lint Runs golangci-lint v2, built with Go 1.27 or later, as the CI does go test -run 'TestDockerImage\|TestImageEnvProfile' . Unit tests, without root nor Docker make tests Tests of the root package, with sudo and Docker make test-templates IMAGE=ubuntu:24.04 Converts an image with its template (TestConfig) make e2e Converts and boots images make examples Builds the examples make cli-docs Regenerates the command reference make serve-docs, make build-docs Serves or builds the documentation site

TestConfig, run by make test-templates, removes the images it converts, even those you had pulled before. Some flag defaults depend on the host: regenerate the command reference on linux/amd64, where the CI checks it with make docs-up-to-date. The CI runs golangci-lint on pushes and pull requests to main, and the tests and builds on pull requests to main and on v* tags. Pushing a v* tag releases oci2vm: the Release workflow pushes the linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 image, then publishes the binaries in a GitHub release with goreleaser, and the Docs workflow deploys the documentation site to the gh-pages branch.

docs.text: oci2vm is licensed under the Apache License 2.0. It derives from d2vm by Linka Cloud, and its run commands are adapted from LinuxKit: see NOTICE. d2vm was inspired by the article and the docker-to-linux project of iximiuz.

docs.title: oci2vm
docs.text:
English | 简体中文

oci2vm 把容器镜像转换成可以启动的虚拟机磁盘镜像。

它从本地 Docker、镜像仓库或 Dockerfile 获取镜像，用镜像所在发行版的包管理器安装 Linux 内核、引导程序、cloud-init 和 OpenSSH 服务端，再写出 qcow2、raw、vmdk、vdi、vhd、vhdx 或 qed 格式的磁盘，可以用 QEMU、libvirt、KubeVirt 或 VirtualBox 启动。虚拟机启动时，镜像的入口程序作为服务运行，镜像的环境变量会导出到登录 shell。

oci2vm 是 Linka Cloud 的 d2vm 的分支，采用 Apache License 2.0 许可证，署名信息见 NOTICE。

docs.title: 工作原理
docs.text:
1. 读取镜像里的 /etc/os-release，选择对应发行版的模板。
  2. 以镜像为基础，按模板构建一个临时镜像，安装内核、init 系统、引导程序的软件包、cloud-init、OpenSSH 服务端和网络配置。
  3. 把临时镜像的各层写入分好区的 raw 磁盘，再配置 fstab、主机名、DNS、入口服务和引导程序。
  4. 用 qemu-img 把 raw 磁盘转换成输出格式。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/jimyag/oci2vm && cd oci2vm
make install
oci2vm convert nginx:1.27-alpine -o nginx.qcow2

下文“完整示例”一节演示了如何构建一个应用镜像，再用 QEMU 启动并通过 SSH 登录。

docs.title: 安装
docs.text:
需要：

  • Docker。
  • Go 和 make，用于从源码构建 oci2vm。
  • 在 Linux 上直接运行时，需要 root 权限（sudo），用来创建 loop 设备和挂载磁盘，并安装以下软件包：util-linux、udev、parted、 e2fsprogs、dosfstools、mount、tar、extlinux、qemu-utils，使用 LUKS 时还要 cryptsetup。

在 macOS、Windows 上，或者在 Linux 上不以 root 运行时，build 和 convert 命令会在 ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm 镜像里执行，这些软件包都已包含在内。Windows 没有测试过。

Releases 直接发布二进制文件，文件名为 oci2vm_<os>_<arch>，附带 checksums.txt；同时发布同一版本的 ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm 镜像，二进制需要时会自动拉取。例如在 Apple 芯片的 macOS 上：

curl -fsSLo oci2vm https://github.com/jimyag/oci2vm/releases/latest/download/oci2vm_darwin_arm64
chmod +x oci2vm && sudo mv oci2vm /usr/local/bin/

从源码构建：

git clone https://github.com/jimyag/oci2vm && cd oci2vm
make install

make install 会把 oci2vm 二进制装到 $GOBIN，并构建同一版本的 ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm 镜像。只想通过 Docker 使用的话，用这个镜像定义一个别名：

alias oci2vm="docker run --rm -it --privileged -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v \$PWD:/oci2vm -w /oci2vm ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm:latest"

使用这个别名时，构建上下文、Dockerfile 和输出文件都必须在当前目录下。

支持 bash、zsh、fish 和 PowerShell 的命令补全：

source <(oci2vm completion zsh)

docs.title: 转换镜像
docs.text:
oci2vm convert IMAGE -o disk.qcow2
  • 本地 Docker 里有这个镜像就直接使用，没有就从镜像仓库拉取。--pull 表示总是重新拉取，--platform linux/arm64 用来选择其他架构。
  • 私有仓库的镜像要先用 docker pull 拉到本地：oci2vm 在自己的镜像里运行时，拿不到你的仓库登录凭据。
  • docker save 或 podman save 导出的镜像 tar 包保留了镜像配置，先导入再转换：
docker load -i app.tar
oci2vm convert app:latest -o app.qcow2
  • docker export 导出的容器文件系统 tar 包没有镜像配置，oci2vm 不会安装入口服务，也不会导出环境变量。导入时可以补上：
docker import --change 'ENV GREETING=hello' --change 'ENTRYPOINT ["/app/server"]' app-fs.tar app:fs
oci2vm convert app:fs -o app.qcow2

镜像必须基于下文“支持的发行版”里列出的发行版，并且带有 cat 和 /etc/os-release。distroless 和 scratch 镜像无法转换。

docs.title: 从 Dockerfile 构建
docs.text:
oci2vm build -f Dockerfile --build-arg VERSION=1.0 -o disk.qcow2 .

build 先对构建上下文目录执行 docker build，再像 convert 一样转换构建出的镜像。转换结束后，这个镜像会被删除； 加上 --keep-cache 时保留。

  • 支持多阶段 Dockerfile：oci2vm 转换的是最终阶段的镜像，它必须基于受支持的发行版。最终阶段请使用 alpine 或 debian:12-slim 这类镜像，不要用 scratch 或 distroless。
  • build 没有 --target 参数。要转换其他阶段，先用 Docker 构建，再转换：
docker build --target debug -t app:debug .
oci2vm convert app:debug -o app-debug.qcow2
  • oci2vm 在自己的镜像里运行时只挂载构建上下文目录，所以 Dockerfile 必须放在这个目录里。

docs.title: 虚拟机里有什么
docs.text:
• 镜像的 ENTRYPOINT 和 CMD 在开机时作为 oci2vm-entrypoint 服务运行，带上镜像的 ENV、WORKDIR 和 USER。 这个服务在 systemd 发行版上是一个 unit，在 Alpine 上是一个 OpenRC 服务。服务执行生成的 /usr/local/bin/oci2vm-entrypoint 脚本，失败后会重启。以下两种情况不安装这个服务：
  • 镜像没有命令；
  • 镜像只启动一个交互式 shell 或解释器，例如 sh、bash、python3、node。发行版镜像和语言镜像通常都是这样。
  • /etc/profile.d/oci2vm-env.sh 把镜像的 ENV 导出到登录 shell，包括 SSH 会话、控制台登录和 su -。 HOME、HOSTNAME、LOGNAME、SHELL、TERM、USER 保持登录会话自己的值。 不经过登录 shell 的命令（例如 ssh host cmd）和其他服务读不到这个文件。CentOS、Rocky Linux、AlmaLinux 例外， 它们的 /etc/bashrc 会读取 /etc/profile.d。
  • 名字不是合法 shell 变量名的环境变量（例如 my-var），入口服务和登录 shell 都会跳过。
  • cloud-init 在开机时从数据源获取用户、SSH 密钥和 user data，例如 NoCloud 或 ConfigDrive 磁盘，KubeVirt 的 cloudInitNoCloud 卷就属于这类：
  • 它的网络配置被关闭（/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/99-oci2vm-network.cfg），网络沿用镜像自己的配置；
  • 装好了 growpart 和 resize2fs，它会把根文件系统扩展到整个磁盘；
  • 在 Debian、Kali 和 Ubuntu 上，它的 locale 模块被关闭（99-oci2vm-locale.cfg），因为容器镜像里没有 locales 软件包；
  • 没有数据源时，ds-identify 会在开机时禁用它。Alpine、Debian 9 和 CentOS 7 没有 ds-identify，所以这三个版本上 cloud-init 只查找 NoCloud 和 ConfigDrive（99-oci2vm-datasource.cfg）。否则它会花上几分钟去等待各云厂商的元数据服务。
  • OpenSSH 服务端开机自动启动。构建时生成的主机密钥会被删除，每台虚拟机首次启动时各自生成。
  • 网络通过 DHCP 配置在 eth0 上：
发行版 网络配置 Ubuntu 18.04 及以上 netplan 加 systemd-networkd Debian、Kali、Alpine ifupdown CentOS、Rocky Linux、AlmaLinux NetworkManager

--network-manager 在 Debian、Kali、Ubuntu 上可以选 netplan、ifupdown 或 none，在 Alpine 上可以选 ifupdown 或 none。 - DNS 服务器默认来自 DHCP，--dns 和 --dns-search 可以指定。--hostname 和 --add-host 分别设置主机名和 /etc/hosts 条目。 - oci2vm 以 root 运行时，输出磁盘归执行 sudo 的用户所有；没有 sudo 信息时，归输出目录的所有者。

--raw 不使用模板，按原样转换镜像。镜像里必须已经有内核和 init 系统，也不会安装 cloud-init 和 OpenSSH 服务端。

docs.title: 磁盘和引导选项
docs.text:
选项 作用 -o disk.EXT 按扩展名决定输出格式：qcow2、qed、raw、vdi、vhd、vhdx、vmdk，没有扩展名时为 raw -s 10G 磁盘大小，默认 10G；开机时 cloud-init 会把根文件系统扩展到这个大小 -p PASSWORD root 密码；更推荐通过 cloud-init 配置 SSH 密钥 --bootloader syslinux（amd64 默认）、grub-bios、grub-efi（arm64 只能用它），以及同时支持 BIOS 和 UEFI 的 grub --split-boot、--boot-fs、--boot-size 独立的启动分区，ext4 或 fat32，默认 100 MB --luks-password 用 LUKS 加密根分区 --append-to-cmdline 追加内核命令行参数 --force 覆盖已存在的输出磁盘

grub 和 grub-efi 使用 FAT32 启动分区；在 CentOS、Rocky Linux、AlmaLinux 上需要 9 及以上版本。Ubuntu 20.04 和 Debian 10 之前的版本不支持 LUKS。全部参数见命令参考。

docs.title: 启动虚拟机
docs.text:
在带 KVM 的 Linux 主机上用 QEMU 启动 amd64 磁盘：

qemu-system-x86_64 -accel kvm -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -drive file=disk.qcow2,if=virtio \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0

在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上用 QEMU 启动 arm64 磁盘，这种磁盘通过 UEFI 启动：

qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt -accel hvf -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -bios /opt/homebrew/share/qemu/edk2-aarch64-code.fd \
  -drive file=disk.qcow2,if=virtio \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0

使用 grub-efi 的 amd64 磁盘同样需要 UEFI 固件，例如 Ubuntu 上的 -bios /usr/share/ovmf/OVMF.fd。 挂载 cloud-init 种子盘时加上 -drive file=seed.iso,if=virtio,format=raw。

oci2vm run qemu、oci2vm run vbox、oci2vm run hetzner 可以分别用 QEMU、VirtualBox 运行磁盘，或者把它放到 Hetzner Cloud 上运行，见命令参考。

用于 KubeVirt 时，--tag 把磁盘打包成 container disk 镜像，--push 把它推送到镜像仓库：

oci2vm convert app:latest -o app.qcow2 --tag registry.example.com/app-disk:latest --push

docs.title: 完整示例
docs.text:
examples/app 用多阶段 Dockerfile 构建一个 Go 写的 Web 服务，最终阶段基于 Alpine。虚拟机把它作为 服务运行，cloud-init 为 root 装上你的 SSH 公钥。

  1. 把 examples/app/user-data 里的公钥换成你自己的。
  2. 构建磁盘：
oci2vm build -o hello.qcow2 examples/app
  1. 制作 cloud-init 种子盘。在 Linux 上用 cloud-image-utils：
cloud-localds seed.iso examples/app/user-data examples/app/meta-data

在 macOS 上：

mkdir seed && cp examples/app/user-data examples/app/meta-data seed/
hdiutil makehybrid -iso -joliet -default-volume-name cidata -o seed.iso seed
  1. 用 QEMU 启动，挂上种子盘，并转发 SSH 和应用的端口。在 Linux amd64 主机上：
qemu-system-x86_64 -accel kvm -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -drive file=hello.qcow2,if=virtio -drive file=seed.iso,if=virtio,format=raw \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22,hostfwd=tcp::8080-:8080 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0

在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上：

qemu-system-aarch64 -M virt -accel hvf -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic \
  -bios /opt/homebrew/share/qemu/edk2-aarch64-code.fd \
  -drive file=hello.qcow2,if=virtio -drive file=seed.iso,if=virtio,format=raw \
  -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22,hostfwd=tcp::8080-:8080 -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=n0
  1. 访问应用，然后登录：
curl http://localhost:8080   # Hello from oci2vm
ssh -p 2222 root@localhost

在虚拟机里，rc-service oci2vm-entrypoint status 可以查看服务状态，echo "$GREETING" 可以看到镜像的环境变量。

examples 目录里还有 Ubuntu、Debian、Alpine 和 CentOS Stream 的 Dockerfile，make examples 会把它们全部构建一遍。

docs.title: 支持的发行版
docs.text:
发行版 测试过的版本 说明 Ubuntu 18.04、20.04、22.04、24.04、26.04 Debian 9、10、11、12、13 9 到 11 从 archive.debian.org 安装软件包 Kali rolling 只在 arm64 上测试过 Alpine 3.16、3.20 到 3.24 使用 OpenRC CentOS 7、8、Stream 8、Stream 9、Stream 10 7、8 和 Stream 8 从 vault.centos.org 安装软件包 Rocky Linux 8、9、10 AlmaLinux 8、9、10

amd64 磁盘在 KVM 上用 syslinux 测试，其中一部分也测了 grub-efi；arm64 磁盘在 Apple 芯片上用 QEMU 和 grub-efi 测试。 不支持 RHEL、其他发行版，以及 distroless 和 scratch 镜像。

docs.title: 限制
docs.text:
• 无法转换 distroless 和 scratch 镜像，也无法转换最终阶段基于它们的多阶段镜像。
  • 用来判断“交互式程序、不装入口服务”的程序名有：sh、ash、bash、dash、zsh、python、python3、node、 irb、jshell。其他交互式命令（例如 php -a）会被装成服务，启动后立即退出。
  • 在 arm64 上，内核命令行指定的串口控制台是 ttyS0，QEMU 的 virt 机型没有这个设备，所以串口上只能看到内核消息， 请通过 SSH 登录。
  • 转换与主机不同架构的镜像时，镜像在模拟器里运行，速度慢；在 Apple 芯片上，CentOS 7 和 Stream 8 生成 initramfs 会失败。 arm64 版的 oci2vm 镜像没有 syslinux，在 arm64 主机上转换 amd64 磁盘时，需要指定 --bootloader grub-bios 或 grub-efi。

docs.title: 开发
docs.text:
命令 作用 make .build 构建 ./oci2vm 二进制 make docker-build 构建 ghcr.io/jimyag/oci2vm:VERSION 镜像 make install 二者都构建，二进制装到 $GOBIN make lint 运行 golangci-lint v2（需用 Go 1.27 或更新版本构建），和 CI 一致 go test -run 'TestDockerImage\|TestImageEnvProfile' . 单元测试，不需要 root 和 Docker make tests 根包的测试，需要 sudo 和 Docker make test-templates IMAGE=ubuntu:24.04 用模板转换指定镜像（TestConfig） make e2e 转换并启动镜像 make examples 构建 examples 里的示例 make cli-docs 重新生成命令参考 make serve-docs、make build-docs 本地预览或构建文档站

make test-templates 运行的 TestConfig 会删除它转换过的镜像，包括你事先拉取的。部分参数的默认值取决于主机， 所以要在 linux/amd64 上重新生成命令参考，CI 也是在 linux/amd64 上用 make docs-up-to-date 检查的。 CI 在推送到 main 和向 main 提交 PR 时运行 golangci-lint，在向 main 提交 PR 和推送 v* tag 时运行测试和构建。 推送 v* tag 即发布新版本：Release workflow 先推送 linux/amd64 和 linux/arm64 镜像，再用 goreleaser 把二进制发布到 GitHub release；Docs workflow 把文档站部署到 gh-pages 分支。

docs.title: 许可证
docs.text: oci2vm 采用 Apache License 2.0 许可证。它派生自 Linka Cloud 的 d2vm， run 子命令改编自 LinuxKit，详见 NOTICE。d2vm 的思路来自 iximiuz 的文章和 docker-to-linux 项目。

docs.title: oci2vm build
docs.text:
Build a vm image from Dockerfile

oci2vm build [context directory] [flags]

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
--add-host strings           Add a custom host-to-IP mapping (host:ip) to the /etc/hosts file in the generated image
      --append-to-cmdline string   Extra kernel cmdline arguments to append to the generated one
      --boot-fs string             Filesystem to use for the boot partition, ext4 or fat32
      --boot-size uint             Size of the boot partition in MB (default 100)
      --bootloader string          Bootloader to use: syslinux, grub, grub-bios, grub-efi, defaults to syslinux on amd64 and grub-efi on arm64
      --build-arg stringArray      Set build-time variables
      --dns strings                DNS servers to set in the generated image, defaults to the ones provided by DHCP
      --dns-search strings         DNS search domains to set in the generated image
  -f, --file string                Name of the Dockerfile
      --force                      Override output qcow2 image
  -h, --help                       help for build
      --hostname string            Hostname to set in the generated image (default "localhost")
      --keep-cache                 Keep the images after the build
      --luks-password string       Password to use for the LUKS encrypted root partition. If not set, the root partition will not be encrypted
      --network-manager string     Network manager to use for the image: none, netplan, ifupdown
  -o, --output string              The output image, the extension determine the image format, raw will be used if none. Supported formats: qcow2 qed raw vdi vhd vhdx vmdk (default "disk0.qcow2")
  -p, --password string            Optional root user password
      --platform string            Platform to use for the container disk image, linux/arm64 and linux/arm64 are supported (default "linux/amd64")
      --pull                       Always pull docker image
      --push                       Push the container disk image to the registry
      --raw                        Just convert the container to virtual machine image without installing anything more
  -s, --size string                The output image size (default "10G")
      --split-boot                 Split the boot partition from the root partition
  -t, --tag string                 Container disk Docker image tag
